messages:
jordan_support: Heads up — we're getting a sharp spike in 502/504 from the hosted inference API after the 06:08 deploy. Multiple customers reporting timeouts and gateway errors :grimacing:. Errors started ~06:12 and climbing quickly.

deploybot: deploy finished: release=v1.22.3 slice=beta-3 at=2026-03-17T06:08:15Z by=ci-pipeline

sam_sre: I'm oncall, looking. Can you paste a couple of request ids and a short log snippet so I can trace across the gateway and pool?

jordan_support: req_ids: req-7b2f, req-7b33, req-7b4a. Logs (gateway):
```
[2026-03-17T06:12:03Z] gateway: upstream response 502 route=api-router slice=beta-3 req=req-7b2f svc=hosted-infer msg="upstream connect error"
[2026-03-17T06:12:04Z] gateway: timeout 504 route=api-router slice=beta-3 req=req-7b33 svc=hosted-infer msg="kvcache miss -> cold start"
```

ben.harper: I see the rollout config change: route-weight for beta-3 was raised from 10%->60% in the staged rollout and a new flag kernelpath=v2 was enabled in the same window. That combo looks risky.

alice.nguyen: Telemetry gap: the edge healthchecks stopped reporting for a subset of nodes around 06:09, so traffic was funneled to the newer pool which is showing cold starts + auth header parsing errors.

carla: Repro: hitting /v1/generate with the same payload from us-east1 returns 502 within ~120ms consistently when routed to beta-3. When we pin to stable pool responses are fine. Quick test script:
```
for i in 1..20; do curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate; done
```

sam_sre: Plan: 1) revert the route-weight bump for beta-3 to restore previous distribution 2) disable kernelpath=v2 for canary 3) monitor 5xx rate and latency. Need someone to run the rollback command now.

ben.harper: I'll run the revert. Pushing config via configsvc:
```
configsvc set rollout.route-weight.beta-3 10 --reason "rollback after 06:08 deploy - 5xx spike"
configsvc unset feature.kernelpath.v2 --scope slice:beta-3
```

deploybot: config change applied by ben.harper at=2026-03-17T06:17:12Z: rollout.route-weight.beta-3=10

sam_sre: I'm watching the error budget dashboard. 5xx rate dropped from 8.7% -> 1.2% over the last 4 minutes. Latency tail improving. Good sign.

lee_product: Support, please prepare a short note for affected customers and flag billing impact if any. Jordan, can you draft a message summarizing what happened and what we changed?

jordan_support: Drafting now — will include timeline, affected endpoints, mitigation steps, and contact for follow-up. No billing hits reported yet, but we will keep an eye on retry churn.

alice.nguyen: Postmortem notes: probable root = simultaneous route-weight increase + enabling kernelpath v2 while some edge healthchecks were flapping -> traffic funneled to under-warmed pool, auth header parsing/metrics gap masked the problem. Follow-ups: add gating rule to prevent feature toggle flips + route-weight > 20% in same rollout window; add anomaly alert for edge-health telemetry gaps.

carla: Confirming: customers who hit the stable pool saw no failures. Will coordinate regression test to validate kernelpath=off on beta-3 before re-enabling.

sam_sre: closing incident channel for now, keeping monitoring on for 30m. If anyone sees new 5xx, ping me directly and reopen.

jordan_support: Thanks all — notifying affected customers and adding timeline to the support ticket. :thumbsup:
